contentHtml:
The Jersey City rental market

Jersey City is one of the strongest rental markets in New Jersey, driven by its direct PATH train access to Lower Manhattan and Midtown, its diverse neighborhoods, and a sustained influx of NYC-priced-out renters. The Heights, Journal Square, Downtown/Grove, and Greenville all have distinct sub-markets with meaningfully different renter demographics and price points.

Demand is strong across the board, but vacancy rates and achievable rents vary significantly by neighborhood. Knowing the micro-market matters.

Rent control

Jersey City has a rent control ordinance (Chapter 260). Buildings with five or more units are generally covered unless the City has an exemption on file, such as the state's 30-year exemption for new construction. On a covered unit, an increase at renewal cannot exceed 4% or the change in the Consumer Price Index, whichever is less, and the building must be registered with the City's Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations. Check your building on the City's rent control map before setting a rent. PPM handles rent control compliance for all properties we manage.

Property management services in Jersey City

Tenant placement

We market your Jersey City rental across Zillow, Realtor.com, Apartments.com, and local channels. Every applicant goes through income verification on the tenant’s share of the rent, a credit and rental history review, and background screening as New Jersey law allows. Our goal is to minimize vacancy and place tenants who stay.

Rent collection

Online rent collection with direct owner disbursements. Late fees enforced as the lease and NJ law allow. You can see every transaction in your owner portal (Buildium).

Maintenance coordination

Maintenance requests received 24/7. We work with a vendor network covering all of Hudson County. Owners approve any repair above their stated threshold.

Financial reporting

Monthly owner statements and 24/7 portal access. Clear, itemized records for every income and expense transaction on your property.

NJ compliance

PPM stays current on rent control registration requirements, CPI adjustment windows, security deposit rules, habitability standards, and just-cause eviction procedures — so you don't have to.

Jersey City has rent control.

Annual rent increases on covered buildings are capped by the city’s rent control ordinance, administered by the City’s Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations, and covered units must be registered. We handle rent control registration and compliance where it applies.
